base_runway_prompt: A 10 second cinematic landscape video with a dynamic camera move: a drone dives through low cloud into a vast mountain valley, sweeping past cliffs, water, mist, and distant sunlight. Photoreal, high detail, natural atmosphere, no people, no text, no logos.
